title: A kinder, gentler philosophy of success
speaker: Alain de Botton

sentences.en: For me they normally happen, these career crises, often, actually, on a Sunday evening, just as the sun is starting to set, and the gap between my hopes for myself and the reality of my life starts to diverge so painfully
sentences.zh: 是这样残酷令我沮丧的只想抱头痛哭我提出这件事是因为我认为不只有我这么感觉。你可能不这么认为但我感觉我们活在一个充满事业恐慌的时代

sentences.en: that I normally end up weeping into a pillow.
sentences.zh: 事业恐慌的时代就在我们认为我们已经理解

sentences.en: I'm mentioning all this -- I'm mentioning all this because I think this is not merely a personal problem; you may think I'm wrong in this, but I think we live in an age when our lives are regularly punctuated by career crises, by moments when what we thought we knew --
sentences.zh: 就在我们认为我们已经理解我们的人生和事业时真实便来恐吓我们现在或许比以前更容易过上好生活但却比以前更难保持冷静或不为事业感到焦虑

sentences.en: about our lives, about our careers -- comes into contact with a threatening sort of reality.
sentences.zh: 或不为事业感到焦虑今天我想要检视我们对事业感到焦虑

sentences.en: It's perhaps easier now than ever before to make a good living.
sentences.zh: 我们对事业感到焦虑的一些原因

sentences.en: It's perhaps harder than ever before to stay calm, to be free of career anxiety.
sentences.zh: 的一些原因为何我们会变成事业焦虑的囚徒不时抱头痛哭

sentences.en: I want to look now, if I may, at some of the reasons why we might be feeling anxiety about our careers.
sentences.zh: 不时抱头痛哭折磨人的因素之一是我们身边的那些势利鬼对那些来访牛津大学的外国友人

sentences.en: Why we might be victims of these career crises, as we're weeping softly into our pillows.
sentences.zh: 对那些来访牛津大学的外国友人我有一个坏消息这里的人都很势利

sentences.en: One of the reasons why we might be suffering is that we are surrounded by snobs.
sentences.zh: 这里的人都很势利有时候英国以外的人会想象势利是英国人特有的个性来自那些乡间别墅和头衔爵位

sentences.en: In a way, I've got some bad news, particularly to anybody who's come to Oxford from abroad.
sentences.zh: 来自那些乡间别墅和头衔爵位坏消息是，并不只是这样势利是一个全球性的问题

sentences.en: There's a real problem with snobbery, because sometimes people from outside the U.K.
sentences.zh: 势利是一个全球性的问题我们是个全球性的组织，这是个全球性的问题它确实存在。势利是什么？

sentences.en: imagine that snobbery is a distinctively U.K. phenomenon, fixated on country houses and titles.
sentences.zh: 它确实存在。势利是什么？势利是以一小部分的你来判别你的全部价值

sentences.en: The bad news is that's not true. Snobbery is a global phenomenon; we are a global organization, this is a global phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 来判别你的全部价值那就是势利。今日最主要的势利就是对职业的势利

sentences.en: What is a snob? A snob is anybody who takes a small part of you, and uses that to come to a complete vision of who you are.
sentences.zh: 就是对职业的势利你在派对中不用一分钟就能体会到当你被问到这个21世纪初最有代表性的问题：你是做什么的？

sentences.en: That is snobbery. The dominant kind of snobbery that exists nowadays is job snobbery.
sentences.zh: 最有代表性的问题：你是做什么的？你的答案将会决定对方接下来的反应对方可能对你在场感到荣幸或是开始看表然后想个借口离开

sentences.en: You encounter it within minutes at a party, when you get asked that famous iconic question of the early 21st century, "What do you do?"
sentences.zh: 或是开始看表然后想个借口离开（笑声）势利鬼的相反，是你的母亲（笑声）不一定是你我的母亲

sentences.en: According to how you answer that question, people are either incredibly delighted to see you, or look at their watch and make their excuses.
sentences.zh: 不一定是你我的母亲而是一个理想母亲的想象一个永远义无反顾的爱你，不在乎你是否功成名就的人

sentences.en: (Laughter) Now, the opposite of a snob is your mother.
sentences.zh: 一个永远义无反顾的爱你，不在乎你是否功成名就的人不幸地，大部分世人都不怀有这种母爱大部分世人决定要花费多少时间

sentences.en: (Laughter) Not necessarily your mother, or indeed mine, but, as it were, the ideal mother, somebody who doesn't care about your achievements.
sentences.zh: 大部分世人决定要花费多少时间给于多少爱，不一定是浪漫的那种爱虽然那也包括在内世人所愿意给我们的关爱、尊重取决于

sentences.en: Unfortunately, most people are not our mothers.
sentences.zh: 取决于我们的社会地位

sentences.en: Most people make a strict correlation between how much time, and if you like, love -- not romantic love, though that may be something -- but love in general, respect -- they are willing to accord us, that will be strictly defined by our position in the social hierarchy.
sentences.zh: 我们的社会地位这就是为什么我们如此在乎事业和成就以及看重金钱和物质的原因我们时常被告知我们处在一个物质挂帅的时代我们都是贪婪的人我并不认为我们特别看重物质

sentences.en: And that's a lot of the reason why we care so much about our careers and indeed start caring so much about material goods.
sentences.zh: 我并不认为我们特别看重物质而是活在一个物质能带来大量情感反馈的时代

sentences.en: You know, we're often told that we live in very materialistic times, that we're all greedy people.
sentences.zh: 的时代我们想要的不是物质，而是背后的情感反馈这赋予奢侈品一个崭新的意义

sentences.en: I don't think we are particularly materialistic.
sentences.zh: 这赋予奢侈品一个崭新的意义下次你看到那些开着法拉利跑车的人

sentences.en: I think we live in a society which has simply pegged certain emotional rewards to the acquisition of material goods.
sentences.zh: 下次你看到那些开着法拉利跑车的人你不要想“这个人很贪婪”而是“这是一个无比脆弱、急需爱的人”也就是说 － （笑声）

sentences.en: It's not the material goods we want; it's the rewards we want.
sentences.zh: 也就是说 － （笑声）

sentences.en: It's a new way of looking at luxury goods.
sentences.zh: 也就是说 － （笑声）同情他们，不要鄙视他们

sentences.en: The next time you see somebody driving a Ferrari, don't think, "This is somebody who's greedy."
sentences.zh: 同情他们，不要鄙视他们还有一些其他的（笑声）

sentences.en: Think, "This is somebody who is incredibly vulnerable and in need of love."
sentences.zh: （笑声）还有一些其他理由，让我们比过去更难获得平静

sentences.en: (Laughter) Feel sympathy, rather than contempt.
sentences.zh: 更难获得平静这有些矛盾因为拥有自己的事业是一件不错的事

sentences.en: There are other reasons -- (Laughter) There are other reasons why it's perhaps harder now to feel calm than ever before.
sentences.zh: 是一件不错的事但同时 人们也从未对自己的短暂一生有过这么高的期待这个世界用许多方法告诉我们 我们无所不能

sentences.en: One of these, and it's paradoxical, because it's linked to something that's rather nice, is the hope we all have for our careers.
sentences.zh: 这个世界用许多方法告诉我们 我们无所不能我们不再受限于阶级而是只要靠着努力就能攀上我们想到的高度

sentences.en: Never before have expectations been so high about what human beings can achieve with their lifespan.
sentences.zh: 就能攀上我们想到的高度这是个美丽的理想出于一种生而平等的精神 我们基本上是平等的

sentences.en: We're told, from many sources, that anyone can achieve anything.
sentences.zh: 出于一种生而平等的精神 我们基本上是平等的没有任何明显的

sentences.en: We've done away with the caste system, we are now in a system where anyone can rise to any position they please.
sentences.zh: 没有任何明显的阶级存在这造成了一个严重的问题

sentences.en: And it's a beautiful idea. Along with that is a kind of spirit of equality; we're all basically equal.
sentences.zh: 这造成了一个严重的问题这个问题是嫉妒嫉妒在今日是一种禁忌话题但这个社会上最普遍的感受，便是嫉妒

sentences.en: There are no strictly defined hierarchies.
sentences.zh: 但这个社会上最普遍的感受，便是嫉妒嫉妒来自生而平等的精神。这么说吧

sentences.en: There is one really big problem with this, and that problem is envy.
sentences.zh: 嫉妒来自生而平等的精神。这么说吧我想在场的各位 或是观看这个影片的众位

sentences.en: Envy, it's a real taboo to mention envy, but if there's one dominant emotion in modern society, that is envy.
sentences.zh: 我想在场的各位 或是观看这个影片的众位很少有人会嫉妒英国女皇虽然她比我们都更加富有住在一个巨大的房子里

sentences.en: And it's linked to the spirit of equality.
sentences.zh: 住在一个巨大的房子里我们不会嫉妒她的原因是她太怪异了

sentences.en: Let me explain. I think it would be very unusual for anyone here, or anyone watching, to be envious of the Queen of England.
sentences.zh: 我们不会嫉妒她的原因是她太怪异了她太怪了我们无法想象自己与她扯上关系，她的语调令人发噱

sentences.en: Even though she is much richer than any of you are, and she's got a very large house, the reason why we don't envy her is because she's too weird.
sentences.zh: 我们无法想象自己与她扯上关系，她的语调令人发噱来自一个奇怪的地方我们与她毫无关联。当你认为你与这个人毫无关联时，你便不会嫉妒越是两个年龄、背景相近的人

sentences.en: (Laughter) She's simply too strange. We can't relate to her, she speaks in a funny way, she comes from an odd place.
sentences.zh: 越是两个年龄、背景相近的人越容易陷入嫉妒的苦海所以千万避免去参加同学会

sentences.en: So we can't relate to her, and when you can't relate to somebody, you don't envy them.
sentences.zh: 所以千万避免去参加同学会因为没有比同学更强烈的参照点了

sentences.en: The closer two people are -- in age, in background, in the process of identification -- the more there's a danger of envy, which is incidentally why none of you should ever go to a school reunion, because there is no stronger reference point than people one was at school with.
sentences.zh: 更强烈的参照点了今日社会的问题是，它把全世界变成了一个学校每个人都穿着牛仔裤，每个人都一样但，并非如此当生而平等的概念遇上现实中悬殊的不平等巨大的压力就出现了

sentences.en: The problem of modern society is it turns the whole world into a school.
sentences.zh: 巨大的压力就出现了今日你变得像比尔-盖茨一样有钱又出名的机会

sentences.en: Everybody's wearing jeans, everybody's the same.
sentences.zh: 有钱又出名的机会大概就跟你在十七世纪

sentences.en: And yet, they're not. So there's a spirit of equality combined with deep inequality, which can make for a very stressful situation.
sentences.zh: 大概就跟你在十七世纪成为法国贵族一样困难但重点是，感觉却差别很大今日的杂志和其它媒体让我们感觉

sentences.en: It's probably as unlikely that you would nowadays become as rich and famous as Bill Gates, as it was unlikely in the 17th century that you would accede to the ranks of the French aristocracy.
sentences.zh: 今日的杂志和其它媒体让我们感觉只要你有冲劲、对科技有一些新颖的想法再加上一个车库，你就可以踏上比尔的道路（笑声）

sentences.en: But the point is, it doesn't feel that way.
sentences.zh: （笑声）我们可以从书店中感受到这些问题所造成的后果

sentences.en: It's made to feel, by magazines and other media outlets, that if you've got energy, a few bright ideas about technology, a garage -- you, too, could start a major thing.
sentences.zh: 我们可以从书店中感受到这些问题所造成的后果当你像我一样到大型书店里的自我帮助书籍类如果你分析现在出版的这些自我帮助类书籍它们基本上分成两种

sentences.en: (Laughter) The consequences of this problem make themselves felt in bookshops.
sentences.zh: 它们基本上分成两种第一种告诉你”你做得到！你能成功！没有不可能！“另外一种则教导你如何处理

sentences.en: When you go to a large bookshop and look at the self-help sections, as I sometimes do -- if you analyze self-help books produced in the world today, there are basically two kinds.
sentences.zh: 另外一种则教导你如何处理我们婉转地称呼为“缺乏自信”或是直接了当地称为“自我感觉极差”这两者中间有着绝对的关联

sentences.en: The first kind tells you, "You can do it! You can make it! Anything's possible!"
sentences.zh: 这两者中间有着绝对的关联一个告诉人们他们无所不能的社会

sentences.en: The other kind tells you how to cope with what we politely call "low self-esteem," or impolitely call, "feeling very bad about yourself."
sentences.zh: 一个告诉人们他们无所不能的社会和缺乏自信有着绝对的关联这是另一件好事也会带来坏影响的例子还有一些其它原因造成我们对事业

sentences.en: There's a real correlation between a society that tells people that they can do anything, and the existence of low self-esteem.
sentences.zh: 还有一些其它原因造成我们对事业对我们在世上的地位感到前所未有的焦虑再一次地，它也和好的概念有关

sentences.en: So that's another way in which something quite positive can have a nasty kickback.
sentences.zh: 再一次地，它也和好的概念有关这个好概念叫做“功绩主义“现在，无论是左倾还是右倾的政治人物

sentences.en: There is another reason why we might be feeling more anxious -- about our careers, about our status in the world today, than ever before.
sentences.zh: 现在，无论是左倾还是右倾的政治人物都同意“功绩主义”是个好事我们应该尽力让我们的社会崇尚“功绩主义”

sentences.en: And it's, again, linked to something nice.
sentences.zh: 我们应该尽力让我们的社会崇尚“功绩主义”换句话说，一个崇尚“功绩主义”的社会是什么样的呢？

sentences.en: And that nice thing is called meritocracy.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，一个崇尚“功绩主义”的社会是什么样的呢？

sentences.en: Everybody, all politicians on Left and Right, agree that meritocracy is a great thing, and we should all be trying to make our societies really, really meritocratic.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，一个崇尚“功绩主义”的社会是什么样的呢？一个崇尚功绩主义的社会相信如果你有才能、精力、和技术你就会飞黄腾达，没有什么能阻止你这是个美好的想法。问题是

sentences.en: In other words -- what is a meritocratic society?
sentences.zh: 这是个美好的想法。问题是如果你打从心里相信那些在社会顶层的人都是精英

sentences.en: A meritocratic society is one in which, if you've got talent and energy and skill, you will get to the top, nothing should hold you back.
sentences.zh: 那些在社会顶层的人都是精英同时你也暗示着，以一种残忍的方法相信那些在社会底层的人

sentences.en: It's a beautiful idea. The problem is, if you really believe in a society where those who merit to get to the top, get to the top, you'll also, by implication, and in a far more nasty way, believe in a society where those who deserve to get to the bottom
sentences.zh: 相信那些在社会底层的人天生就该在社会底层换句话说，你在社会的地位不是偶然而都是你配得的这种想法让失败变得更残忍你知道，在中世纪的英国

sentences.en: also get to the bottom and stay there. In other words, your position in life comes to seem not accidental, but merited and deserved.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在中世纪的英国但你遇见一个非常穷苦的人你会认为他“不走运”直接地说，那些不被幸运之神眷顾的人，不幸的人

sentences.en: And that makes failure seem much more crushing.
sentences.zh: 直接地说，那些不被幸运之神眷顾的人，不幸的人今日，尤其在美国

sentences.en: You know, in the Middle Ages, in England, when you met a very poor person, that person would be described as an "unfortunate" -- literally, somebody who had not been blessed by fortune, an unfortunate.
sentences.zh: 今日，尤其在美国如果人们遇见一些社会底层的人他们被刻薄地形容成“失败者”“不走运”和“失败者”中间有很大的差别这表现了四百年的社会演变

sentences.en: Nowadays, particularly in the United States, if you meet someone at the bottom of society, they may unkindly be described as a "loser."
sentences.zh: 这表现了四百年的社会演变我们对谁该为人生负责看法的改变神不再掌握我们的命运，我们掌握自己的人生如果你做的很好，这是件令人愉快的事

sentences.en: There's a real difference between an unfortunate and a loser, and that shows 400 years of evolution in society and our belief in who is responsible for our lives.
sentences.zh: 如果你做的很好，这是件令人愉快的事相反的情况，就很令人沮丧社会学家 Emil Durkheim 分析发现这提高了自杀率

sentences.en: It's no longer the gods, it's us. We're in the driving seat.
sentences.zh: 这提高了自杀率追求个人主义的已发展国家的自杀率

sentences.en: That's exhilarating if you're doing well, and very crushing if you're not.
sentences.zh: 追求个人主义的已发展国家的自杀率高过于世界上其它地方原因是人们把发生在自己身上的事情

sentences.en: It leads, in the worst cases -- in the analysis of a sociologist like Emil Durkheim -- it leads to increased rates of suicide.
sentences.zh: 原因是人们把发生在自己身上的事情全当作自己的责任人们拥有成功，也拥有失败

sentences.en: There are more suicides in developed, individualistic countries than in any other part of the world.
sentences.zh: 人们拥有成功，也拥有失败有什么方法可以解决刚才提到的这些焦虑呢？

sentences.en: And some of the reason for that is that people take what happens to them extremely personally -- they own their success, but they also own their failure.
sentences.zh: 这些焦虑呢？是有的。我想提出几项先说“功绩主义”也就是相信每个人的地位忠实呈现他的能力我认为这种想法太疯狂了

sentences.en: Is there any relief from some of these pressures that I've been outlining?
sentences.zh: 我认为这种想法太疯狂了我可以支持所有相信这个想法的

sentences.en: I think there is. I just want to turn to a few of them.
sentences.zh: 我可以支持所有相信这个想法的无论是左倾还是右倾的政治家我同样相信功绩主义

sentences.en: Let's take meritocracy. This idea that everybody deserves to get where they get to, I think it's a crazy idea, completely crazy.
sentences.zh: 我同样相信功绩主义但我认为一个完全彻底以能力取决地位的社会是个不可能的梦想

sentences.en: I will support any politician of Left and Right, with any halfway-decent meritocratic idea; I am a meritocrat in that sense.
sentences.zh: 是个不可能的梦想这种我们能创造一个每个人的能力都忠实地被分级好的就到顶端，坏的就到底部而且保证过程毫无差错，这是不可能的

sentences.en: But I think it's insane to believe that we will ever make a society that is genuinely meritocratic; it's an impossible dream.
sentences.zh: 而且保证过程毫无差错，这是不可能的这世上有太多偶然的契机不同的机运，出身疾病，从天而降的意外等等

sentences.en: The idea that we will make a society where literally everybody is graded, the good at the top, bad at the bottom, exactly done as it should be, is impossible.
sentences.zh: 疾病，从天而降的意外等等我们却无法将这些因素分级无法完全忠实的将人分级我很喜欢圣奥古斯丁在“上帝之城”里的一句话

sentences.en: There are simply too many random factors: accidents, accidents of birth, accidents of things dropping on people's heads, illnesses, etc.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢圣奥古斯丁在“上帝之城”里的一句话他说“以社会地位评价人是一种罪”用现在的口吻说

sentences.en: We will never get to grade them, never get to grade people as they should.
sentences.zh: 用现在的口吻说看一个人的名片来决定你是否要和他交谈是罪

sentences.en: I'm drawn to a lovely quote by St. Augustine in "The City of God," where he says, "It's a sin to judge any man by his post."
sentences.zh: 是罪对圣奥古斯丁来说人的价值不在他的社会地位只有神可以决定一个人的价值他将在天使围绕、小号奏鸣

sentences.en: In modern English that would mean it's a sin to come to any view of who you should talk to, dependent on their business card.
sentences.zh: 他将在天使围绕、小号奏鸣天空破开的世界末日给于最后审判如果你是像我一样的世俗论者，这想法太疯狂了

sentences.en: It's not the post that should count. According to St. Augustine, only God can really put everybody in their place; he's going to do that on the Day of Judgment, with angels and trumpets, and the skies will open.
sentences.zh: 如果你是像我一样的世俗论者，这想法太疯狂了但这想法有它的价值换句话说，最好在你开口评论他人之前悬崖勒马你很有可能不知道他人的真正价值这是不可测的

sentences.en: Insane idea, if you're a secularist person, like me.
sentences.zh: 这是不可测的于是我们不该为人下定论

sentences.en: But something very valuable in that idea, nevertheless.
sentences.zh: 于是我们不该为人下定论还有另一种慰藉

sentences.en: In other words, hold your horses when you're coming to judge people.
sentences.zh: 还有另一种慰藉当我们想象人生中的失败

sentences.en: You don't necessarily know what someone's true value is.
sentences.zh: 当我们想象人生中的失败我们恐惧的原因并不只是

sentences.en: That is an unknown part of them, and we shouldn't behave as though it is known.
sentences.zh: 我们恐惧的原因并不只是失去收入，失去地位我们害怕的是他人的评论和嘲笑，它的确存在

sentences.en: There is another source of solace and comfort for all this.
sentences.zh: 我们害怕的是他人的评论和嘲笑，它的确存在今日世界上最会嘲笑人的

sentences.en: When we think about failing in life, when we think about failure, one of the reasons why we fear failing is not just a loss of income, a loss of status.
sentences.zh: 今日世界上最会嘲笑人的便是报纸每天我们打开报纸都能看到那些把生活搞砸的人他们与错误对象共枕，使用错误药物

sentences.en: What we fear is the judgment and ridicule of others.
sentences.zh: 他们与错误对象共枕，使用错误药物通过错误法案，种种

sentences.en: And it exists. The number one organ of ridicule, nowadays, is the newspaper.
sentences.zh: 通过错误法案，种种让人在茶余饭后拿来挖苦的新闻这些人失败了，我们称他们为“失败者”

sentences.en: If you open the newspaper any day of the week, it's full of people who've messed up their lives.
sentences.zh: 这些人失败了，我们称他们为“失败者”还有其它做法吗？

sentences.en: They've slept with the wrong person, taken the wrong substance, passed the wrong piece of legislation -- whatever it is, and then are fit for ridicule.
sentences.zh: 还有其它做法吗？西方传统给了我们一个光荣的选择就是“悲剧”悲剧的艺术来自古希腊

sentences.en: In other words, they have failed. And they are described as "losers."
sentences.zh: 悲剧的艺术来自古希腊西元前五世纪，这是一个专属于描绘人类失败过程的艺术

sentences.en: Now, is there any alternative to this? I think the Western tradition shows us one glorious alternative, which is tragedy.
sentences.zh: 描绘人类失败过程的艺术同时也加入某种程度的同情

sentences.en: Tragic art, as it developed in the theaters of ancient Greece, in the fifth century B.C., was essentially an art form devoted to tracing how people fail, and also according them a level of sympathy,
sentences.zh: 同时也加入某种程度的同情在现代生活并不常给于同情时几年前我思考着这件事我去见“周日运动期刊”如果你还不认识这个小报我建议你也别去读我去找他们聊聊

sentences.en: which ordinary life would not necessarily accord them.
sentences.zh: 我去找他们聊聊西方艺术中最伟大的几个悲剧故事

sentences.en: A few years ago, I was thinking about this, and I went to "The Sunday Sport," a tabloid newspaper I don't recommend you start reading if you're not familiar with it already.
sentences.zh: 西方艺术中最伟大的几个悲剧故事我想知道他们会如何露骨地以新闻的方式在周日下午的新闻台上呈现这些经典悲剧故事

sentences.en: (Laughter) And I went to talk to them about certain of the great tragedies of Western art.
sentences.zh: 呈现这些经典悲剧故事我谈到他们从未耳闻的《奥赛罗》，他们啧啧称奇（笑声）我要求他们以奥赛罗的故事写一句头条

sentences.en: I wanted to see how they would seize the bare bones of certain stories, if they came in as a news item at the news desk on a Saturday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 我要求他们以奥赛罗的故事写一句头条他们写道“移民因爱生恨，刺杀参议员之女”大头条我告诉他们《包法利夫人》的故事

sentences.en: I mentioned Othello; they'd not heard of it but were fascinated.
sentences.zh: 我告诉他们《包法利夫人》的故事他们再一次感到惊异万分

sentences.en: (Laughter) I asked them to write a headline for the story.
sentences.zh: 他们再一次感到惊异万分写道“不伦购物狂信用欺诈，出墙妇女吞砒霜”

sentences.en: They came up with "Love-Crazed Immigrant Kills Senator's Daughter."
sentences.zh: 写道“不伦购物狂信用欺诈，出墙妇女吞砒霜”（笑声）我最喜欢的是

sentences.en: Splashed across the headline. I gave them the plotline of Madame Bovary.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的是这些记者真的很有才我最喜欢的是索福克勒斯的《俄狄浦斯王》

sentences.en: Again, a book they were enchanted to discover.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的是索福克勒斯的《俄狄浦斯王》“与母亲的盲目性爱”

sentences.en: And they wrote "Shopaholic Adulteress Swallows Arsenic After Credit Fraud."
sentences.zh: “与母亲的盲目性爱”（笑声）

sentences.en: (Laughter) And then my favorite -- they really do have a kind of genius of their own, these guys -- my favorite is Sophocles' Oedipus the King: "Sex With Mum Was Blinding."
sentences.zh: （笑声）（掌声）如果同理心的一个极端是这些八卦小报另一个极端便是悲剧和悲剧艺术

sentences.en: (Laughter) (Applause) In a way, if you like, at one end of the spectrum of sympathy, you've got the tabloid newspaper.
sentences.zh: 另一个极端便是悲剧和悲剧艺术我想说的是或许我们该从悲剧艺术中学习你不会说汉姆雷特是个失败者虽然他失败了，他却不是一个失败者

sentences.en: At the other end of the spectrum, you've got tragedy and tragic art.
sentences.zh: 虽然他失败了，他却不是一个失败者我想这就是悲剧所要告诉我们的也是我认为非常重要的一点

sentences.en: And I suppose I'm arguing that we should learn a little bit about what's happening in tragic art.
sentences.zh: 也是我认为非常重要的一点现代社会让我们焦虑的

sentences.en: It would be insane to call Hamlet a loser.
sentences.zh: 现代社会让我们焦虑的另一个缘故是我们除了人类以外没有其它重心

sentences.en: He is not a loser, though he has lost. And I think that is the message of tragedy to us, and why it's so very, very important, I think.
sentences.zh: 我们除了人类以外没有其它重心我们是从古至今的第一个无神社会除了我们自己以外，我们不膜拜任何事物我们对自己评价极高，为什么不呢

sentences.en: The other thing about modern society and why it causes this anxiety, is that we have nothing at its center that is non-human.
sentences.zh: 我们对自己评价极高，为什么不呢我们把人送上月球，达成了许多不可思议的事我们习惯崇拜自己我们的英雄是人类

sentences.en: We are the first society to be living in a world where we don't worship anything other than ourselves.
sentences.zh: 我们的英雄是人类这是一个崭新的情况历史中大部分的社会重心

sentences.en: We think very highly of ourselves, and so we should; we've put people on the Moon, done all sorts of extraordinary things.
sentences.zh: 历史中大部分的社会重心都是敬拜一位人类以外的灵体，神自然力、宇宙总之是人类以外的什么

sentences.en: And so we tend to worship ourselves. Our heroes are human heroes.
sentences.zh: 总之是人类以外的什么我们逐渐失去了这种习惯

sentences.en: That's a very new situation. Most other societies have had, right at their center, the worship of something transcendent: a god, a spirit, a natural force, the universe, whatever it is -- something else that is being worshiped.
sentences.zh: 我们逐渐失去了这种习惯我想这也是我们越来越被大自然吸引的原因虽然我们时常显示是为了健康，但我不这么认为我认为是为了逃避人群的蚁丘逃避人们的疯狂竞争

sentences.en: We've slightly lost the habit of doing that, which is, I think, why we're particularly drawn to nature.
sentences.zh: 逃避人们的疯狂竞争我们的戏剧化这便是为什么我们如此喜欢看海、观赏冰山从外太空观赏地球等等

sentences.en: Not for the sake of our health, though it's often presented that way, but because it's an escape from the human anthill.
sentences.zh: 从外太空观赏地球等等我们希望重新和那些“非人类”的事物有所连接

sentences.en: It's an escape from our own competition, and our own dramas.
sentences.zh: 我们希望重新和那些“非人类”的事物有所连接那对我们来说很重要

sentences.en: And that's why we enjoy looking at glaciers and oceans, and contemplating the Earth from outside its perimeters, etc.
sentences.zh: 那对我们来说很重要我一直在谈论成功和失败成功的有趣之处是

sentences.en: We like to feel in contact with something that is non-human, and that is so deeply important to us.
sentences.zh: 成功的有趣之处是我们时常以为我们知道成功是什么如果我现在说，这个屏幕后面站着一个非常成功的人你心里马上就会产生一些想法

sentences.en: What I think I've been talking about really is success and failure.
sentences.zh: 你心里马上就会产生一些想法你会想，这个人可能很有钱在某些领域赫赫有名

sentences.en: And one of the interesting things about success is that we think we know what it means.
sentences.zh: 在某些领域赫赫有名我对成功的理解是，首先

sentences.en: If I said that there's somebody behind the screen who's very successful, certain ideas would immediately come to mind.
sentences.zh: 我对成功的理解是，首先我是一个对成功非常有兴趣的人，我想要成功我总是想着“要怎样我才能更成功？”但当我渐渐长大，我越来越疑惑

sentences.en: You'd think that person might have made a lot of money, achieved renown in some field.
sentences.zh: 但当我渐渐长大，我越来越疑惑究竟什么是“成功”的真正意义我对成功有一些观察

sentences.en: My own theory of success -- I'm somebody who's very interested in success, I really want to be successful, always thinking, how can I be more successful?
sentences.zh: 我对成功有一些观察你不可能在所有事情上成功我们常听到有关工作和休闲的平衡鬼话。你不可能全部拥有。你就是不能。

sentences.en: But as I get older, I'm also very nuanced about what that word "success" might mean.
sentences.zh: 鬼话。你不可能全部拥有。你就是不能。所有对成功的想象必须承认他们同时也失去了一些东西

sentences.en: Here's an insight that I've had about success: You can't be successful at everything.
sentences.zh: 必须承认他们同时也失去了一些东西放弃了一些东西我想一个智者能接受

sentences.en: We hear a lot of talk about work-life balance.
sentences.zh: 我想一个智者能接受如我所说，总是有什么是我们得不到的

sentences.en: Nonsense. You can't have it all. You can't.
sentences.zh: 如我所说，总是有什么是我们得不到的常常，我们对一个成功

sentences.en: So any vision of success has to admit what it's losing out on, where the element of loss is.
sentences.zh: 常常，我们对一个成功人生的想象不是来自我们自己

sentences.en: And I think any wise life will accept, as I say, that there is going to be an element where we're not succeeding.
sentences.zh: 不是来自我们自己而是来自他人如果你是个男人，你会以父亲做榜样如果你是个女人，你会以母亲做榜样

sentences.en: And the thing about a successful life is that a lot of the time, our ideas of what it would mean to live successfully are not our own.
sentences.zh: 如果你是个女人，你会以母亲做榜样精神分析已经重复说了80年但很少有人真正听进去。但我的确相信这件事我们也会从电视、广告

sentences.en: They're sucked in from other people; chiefly, if you're a man, your father, and if you're a woman, your mother.
sentences.zh: 我们也会从电视、广告各样的市场宣传中得到我们对成功的想象

sentences.en: Psychoanalysis has been drumming home this message for about 80 years.
sentences.zh: 这些东西影响了我们对我们自己的看法、我们想要什么

sentences.en: No one's quite listening hard enough, but I very much believe it's true.
sentences.zh: 对我们自己的看法、我们想要什么当我们听说银行业是个受人尊敬的行业

sentences.en: And we also suck in messages from everything from the television, to advertising, to marketing, etc.
sentences.zh: 当我们听说银行业是个受人尊敬的行业许多人便加入银行业当银行业不再受人尊敬，我们便对银行业失去兴趣

sentences.en: These are hugely powerful forces that define what we want and how we view ourselves.
sentences.zh: 当银行业不再受人尊敬，我们便对银行业失去兴趣我们很能接受建议我想说的是，我们不该放弃

sentences.en: When we're told that banking is a very respectable profession, a lot of us want to go into banking.
sentences.zh: 我想说的是，我们不该放弃我们对成功的想象但必须确定那些都是我们自己想要的

sentences.en: When banking is no longer so respectable, we lose interest in banking.
sentences.zh: 但必须确定那些都是我们自己想要的我们应该专注于我们自己的目标确定这目标是我们真正想要的

sentences.en: We are highly open to suggestion. So what I want to argue for is not that we should give up on our ideas of success, but we should make sure that they are our own.
sentences.zh: 确定这目标是我们真正想要的确定这个梦想蓝图出自自己笔下因为得不到自己想要的已经够糟糕了更糟糕的是，在人生旅程的终点发觉你所追求的

sentences.en: We should focus in on our ideas, and make sure that we own them; that we are truly the authors of our own ambitions.
sentences.zh: 发觉你所追求的从来就不是你真正想要的。我必须在这里做个总结

sentences.en: Because it's bad enough not getting what you want, but it's even worse to have an idea of what it is you want, and find out, at the end of the journey, that it isn't, in fact, what you wanted all along.
sentences.zh: 我必须在这里做个总结但我真正想说的是成功是必要的但请接受自己怪异的想法朝着自己对成功的定义出发确定我们对成功的定义都是出于自己的真心

sentences.en: So, I'm going to end it there. But what I really want to stress is: by all means, success, yes.
sentences.zh: 确定我们对成功的定义都是出于自己的真心非常谢谢各位（鼓掌）

sentences.en: But let's accept the strangeness of some of our ideas.
sentences.zh: （鼓掌）

sentences.en: Let's probe away at our notions of success.
sentences.zh: （鼓掌）

sentences.en: Let's make sure our ideas of success are truly our own.
sentences.zh: （鼓掌）

sentences.en: Thank you very much. (Applause) Chris Anderson: That was fascinating.
sentences.zh: （鼓掌）Chris Anderson: 说的真好。你要如何与自己和解把一个人称为失败者是糟糕的但许多人都想掌握自己的生活

sentences.en: But how do you reconcile this idea of it being bad to think of someone as a "loser," with the idea that a lot of people like, of seizing control of your life,
sentences.zh: 但许多人都想掌握自己的生活一个追求这些的社会难免要有赢家和输家。阿兰·德波顿: 是的，我只是想提出在输赢的过程中，有太多偶然今日我们太讲求

sentences.en: and that a society that encourages that, perhaps has to have some winners and losers?
sentences.zh: 今日我们太讲求所有事情的正义和公平政治人物总是在谈论正义我非常支持正义，我只是觉得那不可能

sentences.en: Alain De Botton: Yes, I think it's merely the randomness of the winning and losing process that I want to stress, because the emphasis nowadays is so much on the justice of everything, and politicians always talk about justice.
sentences.zh: 我非常支持正义，我只是觉得那不可能我们应该尽力尽力去追求正义但我们也应该记得我们所面对的，无论在他们人生中发生过什么偶然总是一个强烈的因素

sentences.en: Now I'm a firm believer in justice, I just think that it's impossible.
sentences.zh: 偶然总是一个强烈的因素我希望大家留一点空间这么想

sentences.en: So we should do everything we can to pursue it, but we should always remember that whoever is facing us, whatever has happened in their lives, there will be a strong element of the haphazard.
sentences.zh: 我希望大家留一点空间这么想不然真令人有一种幽闭恐怖症的感觉Chris Anderson: 我是说，你是否相信在这种温和的哲学下可以产生一个发达的经济？还是你认为那不可行？

sentences.en: That's what I'm trying to leave room for; otherwise, it can get quite claustrophobic.
sentences.zh: 还是你认为那不可行？还是我们这样反复提醒人们也不甚重要？阿兰·德波顿: 梦魇是相信

sentences.en: CA: I mean, do you believe that you can combine your kind of kinder, gentler philosophy of work with a successful economy?
sentences.zh: 阿兰·德波顿: 梦魇是相信恐吓人们是刺激他们发奋的最好办法或是环境越残酷

sentences.en: Or do you think that you can't, but it doesn't matter that much that we're putting too much emphasis on that?
sentences.zh: 或是环境越残酷就会有越多人接受挑战你必须想，你的理想父亲是怎样的？

sentences.en: AB: The nightmare thought is that frightening people is the best way to get work out of them, and that somehow the crueler the environment, the more people will rise to the challenge.
sentences.zh: 你必须想，你的理想父亲是怎样的？你的理想父亲往往是严厉又温和的虽然这界限很难画定我们社会需要的模范性人物，是像一个理想父亲

sentences.en: You want to think, who would you like as your ideal dad?
sentences.zh: 我们社会需要的模范性人物，是像一个理想父亲不要走极端不要完全集权、纯粹纪律

sentences.en: And your ideal dad is somebody who is tough but gentle.
sentences.zh: 不要完全集权、纯粹纪律也不要模糊马虎，乱无规章

sentences.en: And it's a very hard line to make. We need fathers, as it were, the exemplary father figures in society, avoiding the two extremes, which is the authoritarian disciplinarian on the one hand, and on the other, the lax, no-rules option.
sentences.zh: 也不要模糊马虎，乱无规章Chris Anderson: 阿兰·德波顿。阿兰·德波顿：谢谢各位。（鼓掌）

sentences.en: CA: Alain De Botton. AB: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: CA:阿兰·德·博顿。AB:非常感谢。

sentences.en: (Applause)
sentences.zh: （掌声）
